name: Iris ~Kimi ga Ita Toki~
source:
Main character goes to paint in the part and helps an injured dog "Iris" there. After days of nurturing the dog it eventually dies in a traffic incident.

A year has passed since that day. A girl appears before protagonist. She calls herself Iris and requests to live together. Is it only happiness that awaits them?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公到公园写生时，救助了一只名叫“伊莉丝”的受伤小狗。他悉心照料了它一段时间，然而小狗最终还是死于一场交通事故。

自那天起，一年过去了。一位自称伊莉丝的女孩出现在主人公面前，希望能与他一起生活。等待他们的，真的只有幸福吗？

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
